Arthur, I noticed you working on the exercise. How's it going so far? Do you have any questions about connecting the math ratios to balancing chemical equations?

Arthur Burton

That works perfectly for me! I'll bring my competition notes and the problems I've been stuck on. It'll be great to get your input before diving into the group project. See you at 2:30 in the library!
